title: Updated NDC 3.0 - Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe
organization: Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe; submitted to the UNFCCC
temporal_coverage: Historical flood losses and fisheries impacts; flood-risk estimates to 2050 and 2080
methodology: Government NDC summarizes sector risks, losses and climate projections using cited assessments.
limitations: Several quantified flood and fishery estimates are attributed to external studies, not new NDC analysis.

title: Prosperity for All Saotomeans: Priorities to End Poverty, Promote Growth, and Build Resilience in São Tomé and Príncipe - Systematic Country Diagnostic
temporal_coverage: Historical climate observations from 1951 to 2010 and country diagnostic published in 2021
methodology: World Bank diagnostic synthesizes country and sector evidence; trends draw on the Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal.
limitations: Climate trends are historical and based on polynomial fits; they do not represent updated observations.

title: West and Central Africa Region Humanitarian Situation Report No. 1: 1 January to 30 June 2025
temporal_coverage: Regional report dated 29 August 2025; São Tomé and Príncipe section covers recurring risks and events in December 2021, May 2024 and 2025.
methodology: UNICEF operational situation report summarizing country needs, hazards and agency responses for January-June 2025.
limitations: Self-reported operational synthesis; some country hazard details refer to 2021 and 2024 events.

title: Rising Waters, Rising Hopes: Shaping Resilience in São Tomé and Príncipe Through Flood Risk Analysis
organization: World Bank; authors include a Natural Resources Management Specialist and report contributors
temporal_coverage: Summary of World Bank national flood-risk assessment using present-climate data and projections for 2050 and 2080; published 2 May 2024.
methodology: Report-author summary of high-resolution riverine and coastal flood-risk modelling under SSP3-7.0, without additional climate policy.
limitations: Accessible blog summary, not the full technical report; selected household interviews are illustrative, not representative.

title: São Tomé’s Água Grande District advances local disaster resilience
organization: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction, Regional Office for Africa
temporal_coverage: District resilience assessment conducted 7-9 September 2026; article dated 6 October 2026.
methodology: UNDRR account of a district scorecard workshop involving public agencies, civil society and sector representatives.
limitations: The account describes an assessment and draft strategy inputs, not an adopted plan or measured resilience outcomes.

title: Enhance Adaptive Capacity to Floods and Water Security in São Tomé and Principe
organization: United Nations Development Programme, Climate Change Adaptation platform; Global Environment Facility project information
temporal_coverage: Project concept/PIF approval shown as June 2024; webpage presents proposed outcomes and beneficiary estimates, not completed results.
methodology: UNDP project-platform summary of the project concept, target population, design and expected outputs.
limitations: The page labels the funding source as pipeline; stated outcomes and beneficiary reach are planned, not evaluated achievements.
